name: greymicroagent MCP registry template
note: Portable seed copied by bin/greymicroagent to ~/.greymicroagent/agent/mcp_registry.json on first launch only (the copy never overwrites). These carry the deb install-root paths from scripts/package_deb.sh: the deb installs the frozen tree at /opt/greymicroagent. On the dev tree the seeding is skipped because the home registry already exists.

servers.name: memory
servers.note: The fork's designed memory surface: hot/cold tiers, per-row tolerant reads, cold-md covered, bad-args surface as errors. Store at ~/.greymicroagent/memory.

servers.name: knowledge
servers.note: The fork-owned RAG surface (tools rag_status/rag_search/rag_ingest_pdf/rag_ingest_urls/rag_ingest_text/rag_remove/rag_list_sources) over the fork KB at ~/.greymicroagent/dbs; rag_remove refuses without confirm and stages pending-remove.json.

servers.name: greysearch
servers.note: The fork-owned public searxng lane (tools search/search_health), keyless, no private-tree dependency.

servers.name: browser
servers.note: The fork-owned browser lane (tools browser_open/browser_close/browser_health): patchright headless chromium, one shared instance per server, fresh page per call, reads the page back as title + text + top-20 links; browser_health never launches the browser and page content is never written to disk.
